A-SCRIPT-CMD-WHITELIST.title: redis.call/pcall rejects every command outside a fixed single-key whitelist (PING, MGET, SORT, blocking pops ...)

A-SCRIPT-UNDECLARED-KEY.title: redis.call on a key not passed in KEYS is rejected

A-SCRIPT-NUMBER-ARG.title: Lua number arguments to redis.call are stringified with %.14g instead of exact (fpconv) conversion

A-EVAL-SHEBANG.title: EVAL / SCRIPT LOAD do not parse the #!lua shebang line or its flags

A-SCRIPT-ERROR-WORDING.title: Script error texts differ: empty redis.call(), wrong arity, non-string argument, error({})

A-SCRIPT-REPLY-DEPTH.title: A script reply nested deeper than 32 levels fails as a whole instead of being converted

send: local t={} local c=t for i=1,40 do c[1]={} c=c[1] end return t

A-LUA-HELPER-LIBS.title: cjson, cmsgpack, bit, struct and redis.sha1hex are absent (implemented on unmerged cx-lualibs)

A-LUA-SANDBOX-GLOBALS.title: Sandbox strips standard globals Redis keeps: os.clock, loadstring, coroutine, collectgarbage, math.random/randomseed

A-LUA-REDIS-API.title: redis.* helpers absent: error_reply, status_reply, log, REDIS_VERSION_NUM (and acl_check_cmd, set_repl ...)

A-SCRIPT-INSTRUCTION-LIMIT.title: Scripts are aborted after 100,000 Lua instructions (EVAL BUSY error; FUNCTION LOAD instruction-limit error)

send: local i=0 while i<200000 do i=i+1 end return i

A-SCRIPT-NO-BUSY-WINDOW.title: No busy-script window: lua-time-limit/busy-reply-threshold unknown, other clients never see BUSY, SCRIPT KILL answers NOTBUSY

A-ACL-SCRIPTS-NEED-ALLCOMMANDS.title: A user without +@all cannot run EVAL/FCALL even when +@scripting grants them

A-EVALSHA-SHA-CASE.title: EVALSHA / SCRIPT EXISTS sha1 lookup is case-sensitive

A-INFO-ERRORSTATS.title: INFO errorstats section is empty (no errorstat_<PREFIX> counters)

A-FUNCTION-SUBCMD-ARGS.title: FUNCTION LOAD/RESTORE/FLUSH/LIST argument validation and errors differ

A-FUNCTION-LIST-CRLF.title: FUNCTION LIST echoes an unknown argument with raw CR/LF into its error: a forged reply desyncs the connection

A-FUNCTION-REGISTER-ARGS.title: redis.register_function argument validation and messages differ

A-FUNCTION-LOAD-ENV.title: FUNCTION LOAD runs the library body with the full sandbox (math, getmetatable ...) instead of only the redis API

A-FUNCTION-SHEBANG-META.title: Library shebang metadata: duplicate name= accepted (last wins), quoted name rejected

send:
#!lua name=foo name=bar
redis.register_function('foo', function() return 1 end)

A-FUNCTION-LOAD-DENYOOM.title: FUNCTION LOAD is not refused while the server is over maxmemory

A-DEBUG-RELOAD-OPTIONS.title: DEBUG RELOAD accepts no options (NOSAVE/NOFLUSH/MERGE rejected)

SCRIPT-CMD-WHITELIST.title: Scripts may only call whitelisted commands: redis.call('ping') / redis.call('expire', KEYS[1], ...) work on Redis, TomoKV rejects them ("command 'X' is not allowed from scripts")

SCRIPT-UNDECLARED-KEY.title: Standalone Redis lets a script (or function) touch a key it did not declare; TomoKV rejects it ("Script attempted to access an undeclared key")

send:
#!lua name=b1lib
redis.register_function('b1f', function() return redis.call('set', 'foo', 'bar') end)

SCRIPT-INSTR-LIMIT.title: A script that runs more than 100,000 Lua instructions is aborted with BUSY on TomoKV (Redis runs it; lua-time-limit / busy-reply-threshold configs absent)

send: local i = 0 while i < 300000 do i = i + 1 end return i

AOF-IMMUTABLE.title: CONFIG SET appendonly yes is accepted by Redis at runtime; TomoKV answers can't set immutable config (boot-only appendonly)

COMMAND-DOCS-INCOMPLETE.title: COMMAND DOCS carries no 'arguments' (and a placeholder summary/since/group), so redis-cli cannot build command-line hints from the server

INFO-MISSING-FIELDS.title: INFO CPU is an empty bulk on TomoKV (Redis: '# CPU' with used_cpu_sys/used_cpu_user...; numbers are volatile, the difference is the empty section); INFO SERVER also lacks redis_git_sha1/redis_git_dirty (recorded, not compared: volatile)

OBJECT-IDLETIME-ZERO.title: OBJECT IDLETIME is always 0 unless maxmemory is configured (idle clock armed only with maxmemory); Redis reports the idle seconds

ERROR-STATS-ABSENT.title: Failed-command accounting is absent: after a WRONGTYPE GEOADD Redis reports errorstat_WRONGTYPE:count=1 and cmdstat_geoadd ...failed_calls=1; TomoKV has an empty INFO ERRORSTATS and cmdstat lines without usec/failed_calls

CLIENT-LIST-CMD-NAME.title: CLIENT INFO/LIST report cmd=client instead of the full subcommand name cmd=client|info (the line also carries volatile per-connection fields id/addr/fd/age/mem, so read the cmd= field in the recorded replies)

RESET-CLEARS-LIBNAME.title: RESET clears lib-name/lib-ver on TomoKV; Redis keeps the CLIENT SETINFO library name across RESET (read lib-name= in the recorded CLIENT INFO line; the line carries volatile per-connection fields)

CONNECTED-CLIENTS-LAG.title: Killed connections stay counted (connected_clients and the maxclients admission check) until the IO loop's later release: with maxclients 2, after CLIENT KILL of 3 clients a new connection is refused on TomoKV, accepted by Redis

MONITOR-SCRIPT-CMDS.title: MONITOR does not show commands issued by a script: Redis logs the EVAL then '[0 lua] "set" "foo" "bar"'; TomoKV logs only the EVAL (second read TIMEOUT -> the upstream test hangs)

LATENCY-HISTOGRAM-ABSENT.title: Per-command latency tracking is absent: LATENCY HISTOGRAM returns an empty array (Redis: per-command calls + histogram_usec; buckets are volatile, recorded only) and the latency-tracking config does not exist

CONFIG-RUNTIME-IMMUTABLE.title: Configs that Redis can change at runtime are immutable on TomoKV even when set to their current value: port, bind, tls-auth-clients (also hll-sparse-max-bytes, tracking-table-max-keys)

CONFIG-DAEMONIZE-ABSENT.title: The daemonize config does not exist on TomoKV: CONFIG GET daemonize is empty and CONFIG SET daemonize answers Unknown option instead of can't set immutable config

TRACK-BCAST-BATCH.title: BCAST tracking: one invalidation per key instead of one message per prefix carrying every key changed in the same event-loop pass (MSET a b c)

TRACK-INVALIDATE-BEFORE-REPLY.title: Lazy-expire invalidation raised while serving MGET (key tracked by a GET inside MULTI/EXEC) is written BEFORE the MGET reply; Redis defers it until after the reply

TRACK-MAXKEYS-IMMUTABLE.title: CONFIG SET tracking-table-max-keys is refused as immutable (Redis: mutable; the Tcl clean_all helper sets it)

PUBSUB-REPLY-OFF-PUSH.title: CLIENT REPLY OFF/SKIP also swallows pub/sub pushes: no (p)subscribe confirmation (Redis delivers them)

PUBSUB-EVICT-ON-MAXMEMORY.title: CONFIG SET maxmemory below usage does not evict (no 'evicted' keyspace event, key survives); Redis evicts at once

PUBSUB-SUBSCRIBE-NO-DENYOOM.title: SUBSCRIBE/PSUBSCRIBE/SSUBSCRIBE are not rejected with OOM over maxmemory (Redis 7.4.10 marks them DENYOOM); SET is rejected by both

PUBSUB-IMPLICIT-CONSUMER-EVENT.title: Implicit consumer creation (XREADGROUP by a new consumer, XCLAIM to a new consumer) emits no 'xgroup-createconsumer' keyspace event; explicit XGROUP CREATECONSUMER does

PAUSE-BLOCKED-COUNT.title: A client postponed by CLIENT PAUSE WRITE is not counted as blocked: INFO clients blocked_clients:0 (Redis blocked_clients:1, CLIENT LIST flags=b). NOTE the compared INFO reply also differs in its field set (TomoKV prints 4 fields); the discriminating field is blocked_clients

PAUSE-CLIENT-EXEMPT.title: CLIENT PAUSE issued during PAUSE ALL executes at once (Redis postpones it until the ALL pause ends) and its WRITE mode replaces ALL, so a GET is served during the ALL pause

PAUSE-MAY-REPLICATE.title: CLIENT PAUSE WRITE does not postpone may-replicate commands: PFCOUNT and PUBLISH answer at once (Redis postpones both until UNPAUSE)

PAUSE-SCRIPT-FLAGS.title: CLIENT PAUSE WRITE postpones FCALL of a no-writes function (Redis derives the pause decision from the script/function flags and runs it); same for EVAL #!lua flags=no-writes

PAUSE-EXEC-NOT-HELD.title: EXEC of a transaction holding a write is not postponed by CLIENT PAUSE WRITE: it executes during the pause (Redis postpones EXEC until UNPAUSE)

PAUSE-IN-MULTI.title: CLIENT PAUSE queued inside MULTI fails at EXEC with 'ERR unknown subcommand 'PAUSE'' (Redis pauses at the end of the transaction)

MULTI-OOM-QUEUE.title: Under maxmemory OOM a deny-oom command is QUEUED inside MULTI (Redis rejects it with -OOM while queueing and EXEC answers EXECABORT)

MULTI-OOM-EXEC.title: OOM reached between queueing and EXEC: TomoKV executes the transaction with per-command -OOM elements (Redis rejects the whole EXEC: -EXECABORT Transaction discarded because of: OOM ...)

MULTI-XREADGROUP-BLOCK-HANG.title: XREADGROUP ... BLOCK 0 queued in MULTI makes EXEC block forever (Redis runs it non-blocking inside EXEC and answers [nil])

RESET-IN-MULTI.title: RESET inside MULTI is QUEUED and executed by EXEC (Redis executes RESET immediately, discarding the transaction)

RESET-MONITOR-ECHO.title: A MONITOR client that sends RESET first receives its own monitor line for RESET, then +RESET (Redis feeds monitors after execution, so the reply is +RESET only)

DEBUG-LOADAOF-AOF-OFF.title: DEBUG LOADAOF after BGREWRITEAOF with appendonly no: TomoKV answers 'ERR appendonly is disabled' (Redis reloads the rewritten AOF and answers OK)

SLOWLOG-MAXLEN-PER-THREAD.title: slowlog-max-len is enforced per executor thread, so SLOWLOG LEN / GET -1 exceed it (max-len 3, four keyed commands: TomoKV 4 in 2s / 5 in 1s, Redis 3)

SLOWLOG-EXEC-BODY-NOT-LOGGED.title: A slow command executed by EXEC is not logged (SLOWLOG LEN 0; Redis logs the inner command, not EXEC: LEN 1 'debug sleep 0.2')

SLOWLOG-BLOCKED-NOT-LOGGED.title: A BLPOP that blocks and is later served is never written to the slowlog (Redis logs it when it is unblocked)

MULTI-POLICY-REFUSAL.title: Commands on TomoKV's MULTI refusal list (FLUSHALL/FLUSHDB, ACL, (P|S)(UN)SUBSCRIBE, DEBUG RELOAD|LOADAOF) answer 'ERR Command not allowed inside a transaction' and abort the EXEC; Redis queues and executes them

EVAL-SHEBANG-UNPARSED.title: [secondary, masked: not the first failure of any B1 test] EVAL bodies starting with a '#!lua' shebang (with or without flags=) fail to compile on TomoKV; only FUNCTION LOAD parses shebangs. Sits behind PAUSE-SCRIPT-FLAGS / PAUSE-BLOCKED-COUNT in the pause script tests

B2-BLOCK-WAKE-ORDER-MULTI.title: MULTI/EXEC readies two keys: Redis serves waiters key by key in signal order (blist{t} first); TomoKV services ready keys in unordered_map order

B2-BLOCK-MOVE-WRONGTYPE-STRANDS.title: BRPOPLPUSH waiter whose destination is WRONGTYPE gets the error; Redis then serves the next waiter, TomoKV leaves the element and the second waiter blocked forever

B2-BLOCK-WAKE-RENAME-SORTSTORE.title: A waited key created by RENAME or SORT ... STORE wakes BLPOP/XREADGROUP waiters on Redis; TomoKV never publishes these writes

B2-BLOCK-STREAM-REMOVED-NO-UNBLOCK.title: Blocked XREADGROUP is unblocked on Redis when its key is deleted (-NOGROUP), overwritten by another type (-WRONGTYPE) or its group destroyed (-NOGROUP); TomoKV keeps it blocked

B2-BLOCK-CHAIN-ASYNC.title: Chained blocked moves (Linked LMOVEs, pipelined): Redis finishes list1->list2->list3 before the pusher's next command, so LRANGE list3{t} is [foo]; on TomoKV the element is still in flight (in neither list)

steps.raw:
*3
$5
RPUSH
$8
list1{t}
$3
foo
*4
$6
LRANGE
$8
list2{t}
$1
0
$2
-1
*4
$6
LRANGE
$8
list3{t}
$1
0
$2
-1

B2-INFO-TOTAL-BLOCKING-KEYS.title: INFO clients: Redis reports total_blocking_keys / total_blocking_keys_on_nokey; TomoKV has neither field (INFO clients compared whole: other fields differ too, see root)

B2-PAUSE-POSTPONED-NOT-BLOCKED.title: A client postponed by CLIENT PAUSE WRITE counts in INFO blocked_clients on Redis (1); TomoKV reports 0 (INFO compared whole, see root)

B2-INFO-CMDSTAT-FIELDS.title: INFO commandstats: Redis lines carry usec, usec_per_call, failed_calls; TomoKV prints only calls and rejected_calls (usec values are volatile: compare false, see root)

B2-MPOP-ARG-ERROR-TEXT.title: *MPOP non-integer COUNT / numkeys: Redis replies "count/numkeys should be greater than 0", TomoKV the generic integer error

B2-XREAD-PLUS-LAST.title: XREAD with ID "+" (Redis 7.4: read the last entry) is rejected by TomoKV

B2-XRANGE-EXCLUSIVE-SENTINEL.title: XRANGE with an exclusive "(-" start or "(+" end is an error on Redis (invalid stream ID); TomoKV accepts both

B2-STREAM-GROUP-ID-DASH.title: "-" as an ID (0-0) is accepted by Redis in XGROUP SETID and XAUTOCLAIM start; TomoKV rejects it

B2-XAUTOCLAIM-COUNT-RANGE.title: XAUTOCLAIM COUNT above LONG_MAX/16 is "ERR COUNT must be > 0" on Redis; TomoKV accepts it

B2-STREAM-TRIM-APPROX-LIMIT.title: XTRIM/XADD "~" trims only whole macro nodes and LIMIT caps evictions on Redis; TomoKV trims exactly and ignores LIMIT

B2-DUMP-STREAM-REFUSED.title: DUMP of a stream: Redis returns a payload, TomoKV "ERR object could not be serialized"

B2-RESTORE-IDLETIME-FREQ-IGNORED.title: RESTORE ... IDLETIME / FREQ set the LRU idle time / LFU counter on Redis; TomoKV ignores both

B2-SCRIPT-SORT-NOT-ALLOWED.title: redis.call("sort", ...) inside EVAL: Redis runs it, TomoKV refuses (script command whitelist)

B2-APPENDONLY-IMMUTABLE.title: CONFIG SET appendonly yes at runtime: Redis OK, TomoKV "can't set immutable config"
